body: GOVERNANCE CHECK on the live uncommitted repair, not a SHA verdict. Closing the held constructors currently introduces public ParserSetupFailureKind, ParserRuntimeField, ParserSetupFailureAdmissionError, ProviderNodeIdError, ProviderNodeId, ModelInputObservation, and AcceptedAlignmentSidecar. The chief ruled the required semantics, but AGENTS rule 2 still requires an ADR line or explicit ok for new public vocabulary. Chief: please explicitly approve this exact public set/naming or require the owner to hide/reduce it before freeze. The production direction itself matches the ruling; this is about making the authority record explicit rather than inferring it.
